market_summary: During the London/New York overlap, broad dollar/risk assets are exhibiting sharp directional displacement: EURUSD and BTCUSD are extended below their respective Value Area Lows and lower ATR envelopes testing major session lows without climax volume, while US100 displays an intraday reversal back under its Gamma Flip directly into its VWAP/POC cluster. All setups require patience as prices test key liquidity boundaries without clean continuation entries.

signals.rationale: EURUSD trades below VAL (1.10801) and below POC (1.10928), confirming strong session value area rejection. CVD is NEUTRAL (-2147.49) but displays an aggressive negative slope (-8209.13). The market is in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP with price structurally pressured below both VWAP (1.10864) and EMA50 (1.10882). Candles are pressing through the lower ATR band (1.10716), breaking past local S/R 1.10710 toward Session Low (1.10662). RVOL is 1.23 without a yellow spike on this bar, and live price is testing key liquidity near session lows; thus, we hold off chasing the flush.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / trading below falling VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: US100 closed its signal candle above VAH (28203.68) and POC (28115.45) with RVOL 2.194, but the forming candle has reversed aggressively downward into live_price 28129.90. In LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, GEX is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price falling below Gamma Flip 28167.19 toward VWAP (28121.48) and EMA50 (28127.31). Put Wall #1 sits overhead at 28409.12 and Call Wall #1 at 28429.12. CVD is NEUTRAL (-2.03) with a mild slope (+1.53). The rapid sharp drop in the forming bar right into congested VWAP/EMA20/POC support creates high chop risk and conflicting signals between the signal close and live pullback.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / mean-reverting back into VWAP/EMA50 zone
signals.level_event: rejection of Session High 28295.74 and failure below Gamma Flip 28167.19

signals.rationale: BTCUSD is trading far below VAL (72836.73) and POC (73512.29), continuing a strong multi-hour directional downtrend. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. CVD is BEARISH (-0.09) with negative slope (-0.02), aligned with the bearish impulse. Price remains heavily submerged beneath downward-sloping VWAP (73173.73) and EMA50 (73044.51). Price is severely extended below the lower ATR band (71830.04), and the forming candle swept Session Low (71191.90) down to 71141.00 before showing a lower wick. RVOL is 1.696 without fresh yellow RVOL confirmation on the breakdown. The setup is heavily oversold and extended into major session low liquidity, making immediate selling unfavorable.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / steep trend below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: sweep and breakdown of Session Low 71191.90
